full_judgment: 11. On the other hand, Mr. Mozammel Haque, the learned Advocate appearing for the defendant-opposite parties by filing counter affidavit opposes the Rule. He submits that the impugned judgment and decree which was, according to him just, correct and proper. He submits that the impugned judgment is a proper judgment of reversal inasmuch as the lower appellate Court after properly adverting to the evidence on record and to the findings of the trial Court correctly arrived at a finding that Haji Bilat Ali Mondal executed the disputed deeds and the plaintiff failed to prove their case that the deeds are forged. Mr. Mozammel, further submits that the judgment of the trial Court below is shockingly perverse and illegal inasmuch as the said court determined issue No.1 on maintainability of the suit against the established principles of law that all the ejmali properties are to be brought into the Hotch potch of the suit which was correctly noticed by the Appellate Court and in doing so the trial Court did not consider S. A. khatians No.400 and 108 vide Ext. A and A(1) by which the plaintiffs were given earlier 5.23 acres of land by Haji Bilat Ali Mondal but those lands were not brought into the Hotch Potch of the suit. Mr. Mozammel further argues that the originals of the alleged death certificates, which are substantive evidence were not called for, so the certificates of the U.P. Chairman or of the sanitary inspector can not be accepted, when those certificates are against the registered deeds.
